camel_example: aliyun ndr DescribeBlockingPolicies --region cn-hangzhou --BlockingStatus 1 --PageSize 10 --BlockingType ip --EndTime 1788393600000 --NextToken '""' --MaxResults 10 --StartTime 1788307200000 --SortOrder desc --Page 1 --BlockingDirection in --SortField blocking_time --BlockingEntity '203.0.113.10' --SearchKey 'SSH暴力破解' --BlockingProduct cfw --version 2024-01-24 --method POST --force
description_en: Queries the blocking policy retained for the current account by using paging, including its effective status, expiration time, and task statistics
description_zh: 分页查询当前账号保留的封禁策略及生效状态、过期时间和任务统计
kebab_example: aliyun ndr describe-blocking-policies --page 1 --page-size 10 --blocking-type ip --blocking-entity 203.0.113.10 --blocking-direction in --blocking-status 1 --start-time 1788307200000 --end-time 1788393600000 --sort-field blocking_time --sort-order desc --max-results 10 --next-token '""' --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeBlockingPolicies

parameters.help_en: Performs a fuzzy search by blocking entity or tag
parameters.help_zh: 按封禁实体或标签模糊搜索
parameters.name: search_key

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，从 1 开始，省略时为 1
parameters.name: page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. If the value is less than or equal to 0, it is treated as 10. If the value is greater than 100, it is treated as 100. Specify a value from 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页条数，默认 10；小于等于 0 时按 10，大于 100 时按 100。建议传入 1～100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The blocking type filter. A value of ip indicates IPv4 addresses, and a value of domain indicates domain names. If you do not specify this parameter, no filtering by type is performed
parameters.help_zh: 封禁类型筛选。ip 表示 IPv4，domain 表示域名；省略时不按类型筛选
parameters.name: blocking_type

parameters.help_en: The keyword for the blocking entity. Performs a contains match on IPv4 addresses or domain names. If you do not specify this parameter, no filtering by entity is performed
parameters.help_zh: 封禁实体关键词，对 IPv4 或域名做包含匹配；省略时不按实体筛选
parameters.name: blocking_entity

parameters.help_en: The direction filter. Performs an exact match on in, out, or bidirectional. If you do not specify this parameter, no filtering by direction is performed. A value of in does not match bidirectional
parameters.help_zh: 方向筛选，按 in、out 或 bidirectional 精确匹配；省略时不按方向筛选。in 不会同时匹配 bidirectional
parameters.name: blocking_direction

parameters.help_en: The blocking status of the policy. A value of 0 indicates that the policy is not in effect, and a value of 1 indicates that the policy is in effect. To check whether a task is still running, query the task status separately. If you do not specify this parameter, no filtering by this field is performed
parameters.help_zh: 策略封禁状态。0 表示未生效，1 表示已生效；任务是否仍在执行需另查任务状态。 省略时不按该字段筛选
parameters.name: blocking_status

parameters.help_en: The lower bound of the query time range for the policy blocking time. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds and includes the boundary. If you do not specify this parameter, no lower bound is applied
parameters.help_zh: 策略封禁时间的查询下界，Unix 毫秒时间戳，包含边界；省略时不限制下界
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The upper bound of the query time range for the policy blocking time. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds and includes the boundary. If you do not specify this parameter, no upper bound is applied
parameters.help_zh: 策略封禁时间的查询上界，Unix 毫秒时间戳，包含边界；省略时不限制上界
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The sort field. A value of blocking_time sorts by the policy blocking time, which is the default value. A value of blocking_count sorts by the total number of successful task records for the same type and entity, rather than the number of hits
parameters.help_zh: 排序字段。blocking_time 按策略封禁时点排序（默认），blocking_count 按同类型、同实体的成功任务记录总数排序；并非命中数
parameters.name: sort_field

parameters.help_en: The sort order. A value of asc indicates ascending order, and a value of desc indicates descending order. Default value: desc
parameters.help_zh: 排序方向。asc 表示升序，desc 表示降序；默认降序
parameters.name: sort_order

parameters.help_en: A reserved parameter for compatibility. This parameter is not used to control the number of returned records. Use PageSize to specify the number of entries per page
parameters.help_zh: 兼容保留参数，当前不用于控制返回数量；请使用 PageSize 设置每页条数
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: A reserved parameter for compatibility. This operation does not support cursor-based pagination. Omit this parameter and use Page and PageSize. The example uses double quotes in JSON to represent an empty string, which is not a valid cursor
parameters.help_zh: 兼容保留参数，本接口不支持游标分页；请省略此参数，使用 Page 和 PageSize。示例以 JSON 的双引号表示空字符串，不是可用游标
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The blocking product filter. Valid values: cfw and waf
parameters.name: blocking_product

schema.description_en: The processing result of the request

Data.description_en: The business result returned by the operation
Data.description_zh: 本次操作返回的业务结果

List.description_en: The list of blocking policy information on the current page. The list may be empty if no matches are found
List.description_zh: 本页封禁策略信息列表，无匹配时可能为空

items.description_en: The information about a blocking policy

BlockingCount.description_en: The number of successfully executed task records currently retained for the same blocking type and entity, including blocking, unblocking, modifying, and deleting configuration tasks. This is not the number of rule hits. This statistic is not limited by the start and end time filters of the current query
BlockingCount.description_zh: 同一封禁类型和实体当前保留的执行成功任务记录数，包含封禁、解封、修改及删除配置等任务，不是规则命中次数；此统计不受本次起止时点筛选限制
BlockingCount.title_en: 该实体的封禁任务总次数
BlockingCount.title_zh: 该实体的封禁任务总次数

BlockingDirection.description_en: The blocking direction. A value of in indicates inbound, out indicates outbound, and bidirectional indicates both directions. The value may be empty if the policy is not in effect
BlockingDirection.description_zh: 封禁方向。in 表示入方向，out 表示出方向，bidirectional 表示双向。 策略未生效时可能为空
BlockingDirection.title_en: 编辑回显的原始方向，包含CFW时表示CFW方向；WAF始终入向
BlockingDirection.title_zh: 编辑回显的原始方向，包含CFW时表示CFW方向；WAF始终入向

BlockingEntity.description_en: The IPv4 address or domain name of the blocked object
BlockingEntity.description_zh: 封禁对象的 IPv4 地址或域名
BlockingEntity.title_en: 被封禁的实体（IP 或域名）
BlockingEntity.title_zh: 被封禁的实体（IP 或域名）

BlockingExpireTime.description_en: The blocking expiration time, which is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. A value of 0 indicates that the block never expires
BlockingExpireTime.description_zh: 封禁过期时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳。0 表示永不过期
BlockingExpireTime.title_en: 封禁过期时间戳（毫秒），null 表示永不过期
BlockingExpireTime.title_zh: 封禁过期时间戳（毫秒），null 表示永不过期

BlockingProduct.description_en: The blocking product. A value of cfw indicates Cloud Firewall. A value of waf indicates Web Application Firewall (WAF)
BlockingProduct.description_zh: 封禁产品，cfw表示云防火墙，waf表示Web应用防火墙

items.description_en: The blocking product identifier. A value of cfw indicates Cloud Firewall. A value of waf indicates WAF
items.description_zh: 封禁产品标识：cfw为云防火墙，waf为Web应用防火墙
items.title_en: 封禁产品标识：cfw为云防火墙，waf为Web应用防火墙
items.title_zh: 封禁产品标识：cfw为云防火墙，waf为Web应用防火墙

BlockingProduct.title_en: 封禁产品，cfw表示云防火墙，waf表示Web应用防火墙
BlockingProduct.title_zh: 封禁产品，cfw表示云防火墙，waf表示Web应用防火墙

BlockingReason.description_en: The reason for the block. The value may be empty
BlockingReason.title_en: 封禁原因摘要，可能为空
BlockingReason.title_zh: 封禁原因摘要，可能为空

BlockingStatus.description_en: The blocking status of the policy. A value of 0 indicates that the policy is not in effect. A value of 1 indicates that the policy is in effect. To check whether the task is still running, query the task status
BlockingStatus.description_zh: 策略封禁状态。0 表示未生效，1 表示已生效；任务是否仍在执行需另查任务状态
BlockingStatus.title_en: 封禁状态：0-未生效 / 1-已生效
BlockingStatus.title_zh: 封禁状态：0-未生效 / 1-已生效

BlockingTime.description_en: The most recent blocking time of the policy record, which is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. When sorting by blocking_count, the current value is 0, which is not a valid time point. If a valid value is required, sort and query by blocking_time
BlockingTime.description_zh: 策略记录的最近封禁时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳。按 blocking_count 排序时当前为 0，不是有效时点；需要有效值时请按 blocking_time 排序查询
BlockingTime.title_en: 封禁配置添加时间，Unix毫秒时间戳
BlockingTime.title_zh: 封禁配置添加时间，Unix毫秒时间戳

BlockingType.description_en: The object type of the block. A value of ip indicates an IPv4 address. A value of domain indicates a domain name
BlockingType.description_zh: 封禁对象类型。ip 表示 IPv4 地址，domain 表示域名

DisplayBlockingDirection.description_en: The union of the Cloud Firewall and WAF directions displayed in the list. This parameter cannot be used as an edit and save parameter
DisplayBlockingDirection.description_zh: 列表展示的CFW和WAF方向并集；不可作为编辑保存参数
DisplayBlockingDirection.title_en: 列表展示的CFW和WAF方向并集；不可作为编辑保存参数
DisplayBlockingDirection.title_zh: 列表展示的CFW和WAF方向并集；不可作为编辑保存参数

PendingTaskCount.description_en: The number of task records that are pending or being executed for the same blocking type and entity, including blocking and unblocking tasks. This is not the number of policies
PendingTaskCount.description_zh: 同一封禁类型和实体当前待执行或执行中的任务记录数，包含封禁和解封任务，不是策略数量
PendingTaskCount.title_en: 该实体待生效的封禁任务个数
PendingTaskCount.title_zh: 该实体待生效的封禁任务个数

WafAllInstances.description_en: The selection scope of WAF instances. A value of true indicates all instances. A value of false indicates specified instances. If the historical configuration is not recorded, the value is backfilled based on the specified instances
WafAllInstances.description_zh: WAF 实例选择范围。true 为全部实例，false 为指定实例。历史配置未记录时按指定实例回填
WafAllInstances.title_en: WAF 实例选择范围。true 为全部实例，false 为指定实例。历史配置未记录时按指定实例回填。
WafAllInstances.title_zh: WAF 实例选择范围。true 为全部实例，false 为指定实例。历史配置未记录时按指定实例回填。

WafBlockingStatus.description_en: The overall blocking status of the selected WAF instances. Valid values: not_blocked (not blocked), full (fully blocked), partial (partially blocked), and failed (blocking failed)
WafBlockingStatus.description_zh: 所选WAF实例的封禁汇总状态：not_blocked未封禁、full全部封禁、partial部分封禁、failed封禁失败
WafBlockingStatus.title_en: 所选WAF实例的封禁汇总状态：not_blocked未封禁、full全部封禁、partial部分封禁、failed封禁失败
WafBlockingStatus.title_zh: 所选WAF实例的封禁汇总状态：not_blocked未封禁、full全部封禁、partial部分封禁、failed封禁失败

WafInstances.description_en: The fixed scope of WAF instances selected by the user. Newly added instances are not automatically included
WafInstances.description_zh: 用户选择的固定WAF实例范围，新增实例不自动纳入

MemberUid.description_en: The UID of the Alibaba Cloud account or member accounts to which the instance belongs
MemberUid.description_zh: 实例所属主账号或成员账号UID
MemberUid.title_en: 实例所属主账号或成员账号UID
MemberUid.title_zh: 实例所属主账号或成员账号UID

WafInstances.title_en: 用户选择的固定WAF实例范围，新增实例不自动纳入
WafInstances.title_zh: 用户选择的固定WAF实例范围，新增实例不自动纳入

Page.description_en: The page number used for the current query, starting from 1
Page.description_zh: 本次查询采用的页码，从 1 开始

PageSize.description_en: The page size used for the current query, which is not equal to the actual number of entries returned on the current page
PageSize.description_zh: 本次采用的分页大小，不等于本页实际返回条数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of policies that meet the filter conditions, not the number of entries returned on the current page
TotalCount.description_zh: 符合筛选条件的策略总数，不是本页返回条数

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned when the request fails. The value is an empty string if the request is successful. The example InvalidParam indicates that the request parameter is invalid and does not represent the error code of a successful response
ErrorCode.description_zh: 请求失败时的错误码；成功时为空字符串。示例 InvalidParam 表示请求参数无效，不代表成功响应的错误码

MaxResults.description_en: A reserved field for compatibility. This field does not provide a valid page size. Refer to Data.PageSize. The example only illustrates the field format
MaxResults.description_zh: 兼容保留字段，当前不提供有效分页大小；请以 Data.PageSize 为准。示例仅说明字段格式
MaxResults.title_en: 单次请求期望返回的最大记录数
MaxResults.title_zh: 单次请求期望返回的最大记录数

Message.description_en: The result description of the request. The value is success if the request is successful, or an error message if the request fails
Message.description_zh: 本次请求的结果说明；成功时为 success，失败时返回错误说明

NextToken.description_en: A reserved field for compatibility. This API operation does not provide a next page cursor. Paginate based on Data.TotalCount, Data.Page, and Data.PageSize. The example uses double quotes in JSON to represent an empty string, which is not a valid cursor
NextToken.description_zh: 兼容保留字段，本接口不提供下一页游标；请依据 Data.TotalCount、Data.Page 和 Data.PageSize 翻页。示例以 JSON 的双引号表示空字符串，不是可用游标
NextToken.title_en: 分页查询使用的后续页标记
NextToken.title_zh: 分页查询使用的后续页标记

RequestId.description_en: The request ID used to troubleshoot and locate the request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于排查和定位本次请求

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the API call is successful. A value of true indicates that the request is processed successfully. A value of false indicates that the request fails. For asynchronous API operations, a value of true does not indicate that the task is completed
Success.description_zh: 本次接口调用是否成功。true 表示请求处理成功，false 表示失败；异步接口的成功不表示任务已经执行完成
